description: "The Adventures of Sir Launcelot Greaves" by Tobias Smollett is a novel likely written in the mid-18th century.
longDescription: This tale follows the protagonist, Sir Launcelot Greaves, who aspires to become a knight-errant, embarking on a quest to uphold virtue and justice, echoing the themes of chivalry and adventure present in romantic literature.

authorInfo.bio: T. (Tobias) Smollett (1721–1771) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include The Expedition of Humphry Clinker, The Adventures of Ferdinand Count Fathom — Complete, The Adventures of Roderick Random. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
